contact.full_name: BIKAS J DAS PROJECT MANAGER — PAYMENTS & BANKING Phone: +91 8591823307 | Email: bikasdas08@gmail.com

data.summary:
Result-oriented Project Manager offering over 13+ years of progressive expertise in Banking and Financial Services (BFSI). Proven track record of 10+ years managing cross-functional project teams, leading end-to-end delivery schedules, optimizing business processes, and executing high-impact system modernizations across Cash Management Services (CMS), ISO 20022 Payments Migration, SWIFT Sanctions Screening, Payment Gateways, and Retail Banking. Adept at bridging business and technology teams, managing project Scope, Schedule, and Budget, and leveraging AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Open Code AI) to accelerate legacy codebase analysis and deliver actionable functional specifications. Expert in complete Project & SDLC Management, Agile Backlog Management, Risk Mitigation, Resource Allocation, and Stakeholder Alignment in high-volume payment ecosystems.
KEY CAREER HIGHLIGHTS
AI-Driven Application Migration: Accelerated the modernization of retail legacy applications (BMM to MWS) across ~30 business functions at HSBC by leveraging GitHub Copilot and Open Code AI tools.
ISO 20022 & SWIFT Modernization: Managed Citi Bank's ISO Migration project transitioning MT messages to MX standards (PAIN, PACS, CAMT) alongside SWIFT SAM Sanctions Screening integration.
API Banking & Module Overhaul: Spearheaded project delivery for the complete revamp of the Multi-City Cheque (MCC) module and integrated Real-Time and Bulk API Banking solutions at State Bank of India (SBI).
International Payment Gateway Launch: Directed the project implementation for BayanPay Payment Ltd (KSA) Payment Gateway integration with strict adherence to regional compliance protocols, digital wallets, and merchant dashboards.
Government Payments & Reconciliation: Functioned as Application Owner and Project Manager for PFMS at HDFC Bank (ACH, NHM) and designed an automated daily Reconciliation Module for GL Pool accounts.
Enterprise Product Innovation: Led the project launch of the "Virtual Pool" liquidity management solution for elite corporate accounts at Axis Bank, along with automated CBA and charge reversal tools.
CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS
Project Management & Governance: End-to-End Project Delivery, Scope & Schedule Management, Risk Assessment & Mitigation, Resource Allocation, Budget Tracking, Agile/Scrum & Waterfall, Stakeholder Alignment, Vendor Management.
Payments Domain: ISO 20022 Migration (PAIN, PACS, CAMT), SWIFT Messaging, NACH/ACH, NEFT, RTGS, Payment Gateways, Real-time & Bulk API Banking, Cash Management Services (CMS), Sanctions Screening, PFMS.
Requirements & Delivery: Business Requirements Document (BRD), Functional Specifications Document (FSD), Gap Analysis, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Product Backlog Refinement, Business Process Modeling (BPMN).
Testing, Delivery & Execution: User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Planning & Governance, Defect Management, Go-Live Strategy, Post- Implementation Support.
